## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), certifying the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/).
- [ ] This pull request makes one change.
- [ ] New functionality has tests, and a bug fix has a regression test (or the description says why not).
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally (lint and format, typecheck, tests with coverage, public-repo check, secret scan).
- [ ] `README.md`, `docs/` and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated for anything people see or configure.
- [ ] No keys, tokens or Sage data files (settings, notes, reminders, the action log, the key file) are included.
- [ ] Changes to skills, the ask-first gate, the key store, the window's security settings or IPC are called out above.
